Dear Gran,
We arrived in Valmora on Sunday after 11 hours on the train! The flat is on the 5th floor (no lift) but the view of the cathedral is worth every step. Yesterday we walked 18 km and had the best hot chocolate I've ever tasted, for €3.20. It's 31° today so we're off to the lake.
Lots of love,
Maya and Ben x

TARTE TATIN (serves 6)
150 g caster sugar, 50 g butter, 6 firm apples, 1 sheet puff pastry (approx. 230 g)
Oven 200 °C / gas 6. Melt the sugar in a 24 cm ovenproof pan until amber, then stir in the butter.
Arrange the apple quarters tightly, cook for 10 min, cover with the pastry and bake for 25–30 min.
Rest 5 min before turning out.

THE OLD TOWN
The heart of Valmora lies within the medieval walls, a 2.4 km circuit that can be walked in under an hour. Most visitors enter through the Porta Nova, rebuilt in 1782 after a fire destroyed the original gate.
From here, Via Lunga runs straight to the cathedral square. Look up as you walk: many of the houses still carry their builders' marks and dates, the oldest from 1438.

A SHORT HISTORY OF THE PONT NEUF
Despite its name, the Pont Neuf is the oldest surviving bridge in the city. Work began in 1561 and took nearly 30 years; its seven arches span 186 m of the river.
In 1944 two arches were damaged, and the bridge was closed until 1951. A plaque on the third pier records the flood of 12 November 1872, when the water rose 6.3 m above its usual level.

THE CATHEDRAL OF ST MARTIN
The present building was begun in 1218 and consecrated in 1302, though the north tower was only finished in 1567. Its spire, 96 m high, was for two centuries the tallest structure in the region.
The tower can be climbed daily from 10:00 to 17:00 (last entry 16:30). There are 312 steps and no lift; the climb takes about 20 minutes. Admission €4, children under 10 free.

BIRDS OF THE RIVERBANK
Between April and September up to 40 pairs of sand martins nest in the bank below the old mill. Each burrow is around 60 cm long, and the birds return to the same colony year after year from West Africa, a journey of more than 4,000 km.
Please keep dogs on a lead between the footbridge and the weir, and do not climb the bank. Report any disturbance to the ranger on 555-0171.
